miya.title: Moonlight Archer
miya.blurb: The Priestess of the Moon and protector of the Moonlit Forest
miya.brief: Born at the end of the Era of Strife, Miya bore witness to the unspeakable tragedies that befell the elves during the Endless War. She saw how the Abyss defiled the Shadow Swamp and corrupted many of her people into Dark Elves. It was not until the Moon Goddess created the Lunar Aegis over Azrya that the Moon Elves were able to thrive again under its protection. Miya became the Priestess of the Moon, and for thousands of years she served faithfully in the Lunar Temple, diligently watching over her people. However, with the continued expansion of the Abyss and its dark legions, the Land of Dawn is once again shrouded by the fog of war. From the Moonlit Forest, a call to war that has not been heard in thousands of years sounded again. Miya took up her silver bow and swore by the light of the moon to fight for her people.

balmond.brief: Balmond is the leader of the Orcs, leading the Orc army against the invasion of the Demons. During a battle, he consumed the blood of a Blood Demon and went into a rage. This aroused Alice's interest, so she signed a contract with Balmond on the condition of returning the Stormeye Wasteland. Balmond, and his Orc army have since fought for the Demons.

The torture of his memories drove him to finally destroy the laboratory and set off searching for the past.

weak.d: Saber is countered by Support heroes with Survivability buffs, like Estes and Faramis.

alice.title: Queen of Blood
alice.blurb: Queen of the Blood Demons and one of the two dominant powers in the Abyss.
alice.brief: Love was once everything to Alice - her maiden dreams, the measure of her worth, and the faith that drove her to protect her family even while imprisoned by the Monastery of Light. In the end, love became the very shackles that bound her to her family. When the lies were finally exposed, Alice saw with clarity that power and authority were the only truths in this world. She paved a path of bones to become the Abyss's Queen of Blood. Alice would never allow herself to be a pawn again - from her new throne, she would be the one who moved the pieces.

nana.title: Sweet Leonin
nana.brief: In order to have the means of controlling the magic in her body and stop causing trouble, Nana went to the Shadow Swamp in search of a magical fruit with her good friend Molina. But when danger came, Molina died protecting Nana. Although Nana got what she wanted, she also lost her friend. With the strength that Molina left her, Nana embarked on a new journey.

tigreal.blurb: Leader of the Light's Order, guardian of the Moniyan Empire.
tigreal.brief: Tigreal is the rising star of the Moniyan Empire. But in a battle, the Second Army that he was leading went deep into the enemy territory alone under the orders of high-level officials and suffered heavy losses, for which Tigreal was eventually forced to take responsibility. Because of this, he left the Empire and came to the Northern Vale. During this period of time, Tigreal finally resolved the problems in his mind. Eventually, he returned to the Empire and became the leader of the Light's Order.

Therefore, he hated darkness, joined the Monastery of Light, and swore to destory all Demons. But later he learned the hidden secrets of this battle, so he left the Monastery of Light in anger and fought the darkness in his own way.

karina.blurb: Killer from the Dark Elf tribe who is fighting to rescue her sister Selena.
karina.brief: Karina is the best killer among the Dark Elves who lived codependently with her younger sister Selena. But as the older sister, Karina failed to prevent Selena from dedicating herself to the Abyss. In order to stop her sister's evil deeds, and to find a way to bring her back, Karina embarked on a new journey.

weak.d: Karina is countered by Tanky heroes with CC abilities, like Akai and Khufra because they can tank her damage, and protect their allies from her.

akai.blurb: The almighty panda hero of Stream Valley.
akai.brief: Once there was a panda in Stream Valley named Akai. With the dream of becoming a hero, he was always eager to offer help, but often ended up causing more trouble instead. He worked hard to pursue his dream, and although he'd once wandered off right the path. In the end, he recalled his original intention and become a true hero.

bruno.title: The Protector
bruno.blurb: The captain of the Eruditio Rangers that protects the city with his amazing football skills.
bruno.brief: Bruno, the current captain of the Eruditio Rangers and a star footballer, had a very eventful past. Born in the Agelta Drylands, Bruno grew up in a remote village surrounded by poverty. But it was those hardships that fueled his longing for freedom. As soon as he was of age, Bruno joined a caravan in hopes of seeing the world. Unfortunately, a tragic accident robbed him of his legs and his freedom. But fate was on his side, for when the caravan passed him through Eruditio, Bruno was offered a second chance. Although it came with great risk, he was so touched by the passion of the city that he decided to take that chance, and in the end of his courage paid off. He not only regained his legs, but was now faster than ever. Instead of continuing his travels, he decided to remain in Eruditio and become its protector. He vowed to uphold the ideals of the Oasis in the desert and help others find true freedom.

Argus finally fell into the Abyss, but was helpless to do anything about. She is an angel whom people admire, but her elder brother continues to perish in pain.

eudora.brief: Eudora is a Light Elf who possesses a high level of magical talent, yet always loses control of her emotions because of her being discriminated against due to her Elf status. Later, she was discovered by the mentor of the Magic Academy, Theresa, who took her to the Magic Academy to study. Finally, she overcame the gloom in her heart and succeeded Theresa, becoming the dean of the Ulturia School.

weak.d: Eudora lacks self-preservation and struggles against dive heroes or Assassins who can negate targeted CC, such as Hayabusa and Kadita.

zilong.title: Spear of Dragon
zilong.blurb: Guardian of the Dragon Altar and the Oriental Fighter who inherited the Cloud Dragon's power.
zilong.brief: Zilong was taken in by the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect when he was just a child. Although the Sect was famous for their mastery of the "Jian," Zilong chose to take up the spear. Without a teacher, he practiced the basics of the spear day in and day out with unwavering determination. After leaving the Sect, he became a disciple of the Great Dragon under the guidance of Baxia, the Mystic Tortoise, and trained at the Dragon Altar. But with the changing of the times, the spirit of the Cloud Dragon appeared on the tip of his spear one day to the surprise of his peers. That was when everyone, including Zilong, realized he had become one with the Cloud Dragon of the Oriental Fighters and inherited the Great Dragon Spear. Even though the spear is known as the "King of Weapons," Zilong had no desire for power. No matter where he was or who he was supposed to be, Zilong was content to protect his homeland with a spear in hand. As long as he still breathed, there would be peace in the Cadia Riverlands.

strong.d: The immunity to Slow effects that Zilong gets from his Ultimate makes him strong against squishy heroes without CC skills, such as Layla and Lylia.

weak.d: Zilong is still vulnerable to non-slow CC skills, making him weak against heroes with powerful single-target CC skills, such as Franco and Nana.

fanny.title: Blade Dancer
fanny.blurb: A blade dancer in the battlefield.
fanny.brief: Fanny is the younger sister of Tigreal, who grew up under the protection of her family and her elder brother since she was a child. But Tigreal took the blame for a mistake in battle and left home. Disregarding obstructions from her family, Fanny joined the army, and through her own designed weapons, she successfully completed one task after another, becoming an outstanding fighter who can take care of herself.

strong.d: Fanny counters squishy heroes that lack targeted CC like Karrie and Irithel who cannot stop Fanny's extreme mobility while she bursts them down.

weak.d: Fanny is countered by heroes that can restrict mobility, such as Kaja and Khufra, since they can easily shutdown her main advantage.

layla.title: Energy Gunner
layla.blurb: The backbone of the Eruditio Rangers who is also known as the Shining Star.
layla.brief: In Eruditio—the City of Scholars, there's hardly anyone who doesn't know of Layla. She's the "daughter of Eruditio", just like a bright star that shines over the streets of Eruditio in the darkness of night. Brave and selfless, she always had a bright and happy smile on her face while toting the gun handed to her by her grandfather, protecting Eruditio in her own way. As a child, Layla would always ask her grandfather about her parents, but his reluctance to tell her and his sad face told her it was something tragic. Because of that, Layla decided to never pain her grandfather anymore, so she stopped pursuing the matter. However, as secrets cannot be hidden forever, the truth of her birth eventually surfaced, and it turns out that her parents have always been watching her from the skies—well, in the literal sense.

strong.d: Layla's relatively longer attack range lets her counter slow Tanks like Tigreal and Belerick.

weak.d: Layla is countered by Assassins with high burst damage, such as Karina and Ling, as they can get the jump on Layla and melt her easily.

minotaur.title: Son of Minos
minotaur.blurb: Minoan prince determined to restore his homeland.
minotaur.brief: In olden times, there was once a state named Minoa in Agelta Drylands. The prince in the state, Minotaur fatally injured his father in a fit of rage, after which he exiled himself to the Minoan Labyrinth in shame and regret. When he stepped out of the Labyrinth again, he found his state had long perished, his kin long gone. With his teeth set, Monitor embark on the path to restoring his homeland to its former glory.

lolita.title: Steel Elf
lolita.blurb: Member of the Eruditio Rangers and protector of the Leviathan workshop.
lolita.brief: Lolita was a gentle and tenacious half-elf girl. After she was rescued from the war and brought to Eruditio, she became a craftsman in the workshop. But she had an uncommon ambition: to join the Eruditio Rangers and fight like those who had rescued her. However, every battle proved to be overwhelming for her, because although she was a good fighter, she couldn't bear to hurt anyone. During an attack on the workshop, Lolita protected the Noumenon Energy Core with her body and was severely wounded. It was through this incident that her courage was acknowledged by the Eruditio Rangers, and they decided to take her in. Eventually, she understood that it didn't matter if one had destructive powers, because protecting too requires courage, and gentleness itself is also strength.

hayabusa.title: Crimson Shadow
hayabusa.blurb: The young leader of the Shadow Sect who wields his blade through moonless nights, walking the path of nindo without fear.
hayabusa.brief: As the second heir to the Shadow Sect of the Scarlet Shadow, Hayabusa had always looked up to his brother, a figure who he saw as the moon itself. To preserve the delicate balance of power between the Shadow and Scarlet Sects, Hayabusa willingly took his brother's place to be a political pawn and hostage, to be raised within the rival Scarlet Sect. Every day spent in the Scarlet Sect, Hayabusa lived by his brother's principles. He mastered his unique Shadow Shuriken technique and forged an unbreakable bond with Hanabi, a kunoichi of the Scarlet Sect. But when Hanzo's betrayal and his brother's disappearance shattered their hopes for peace, Hayabusa realized that the moonlight that had always guided him was gone. Yet, he gripped his blade firmly, determined to forge ahead through the shadows, following his brother's nindo.

strong.d: Hayabusa counters squishy heroes that lack CC to shutdown the blinks from his 2nd Skill, and who are also easy targets for his Ultimate, such as Chang'e and Cecilion.

weak.d: Hayabusa is countered by heroes with targeted CC like Franco and Kaja who can lock him down before he can blink away.

freya.title: Valkyrie
freya.blurb: The Valkyrie who guards the Northern Vale.
freya.brief: Since the fall of the previous Valkyrie and disappearance of the Aurora Heart, Sessrumnir's sacred legacy, Freya has embarked upon an arduous quest to uncover the truth and reclaim their lost relic. Through howling winds and endless snow she journeyed, her sword ever at her side, driven by unwavering faith to protect Northern Vale as she rescues countless souls trapped within the merciless snowstorms. In time, the lost Valkyrie tradition blazed anew within Freya's heart, echoing the founder of Sessrumnir from times long forgotten. With the aurora as her guide and the tundra as her witness, Freya carved her glory into the wind and ice, and cast her body into an invincible weapon to become the new Valkyrie.

sun.title: Monkey King
sun.blurb: The immortal Monkey King, resolute and unyielding like the mountain that bore him.
sun.brief: Sun, the immortal mountain spirit born from a magical stone, roamed freely between heaven and earth until one day, when the cries of a group of pandas caught his attention. It was from them that he learned the existence of death. While confused by this sudden revelation, he was mistaken by the pandas for the deity of the mountain. In particular, a small panda named Li Li became infatuated with Sun and devoted his days to picking peaches for the Monkey King. But when a flash flood struck the panda village one day, Li Li was lost to the torrents while looking for peaches. Sun arrived too late, and despite the pleas of the other pandas, he did not have the ability to bring his friend back from the dead. It was then that Sun experienced loss for the first time. Unable to comprehend his grief, he fell into a deep slumber. Millennia passed, and many more would have passed by had Sun not been awakened by a battle between dragons. After slaying the Black Dragon and unknowingly saving the Cadia Riverlands, he asked the Silver Dragon about immortality and finding one's purpose. Instead of the answer he sought, the dragon gave him the name Sun and the task of being the guardian of the land. But what does that entail? Sun was once again lost in thought...

moskov.title: Spear of Quiescence
moskov.blurb: A warrior of the desert that embraced the darkness to seek his revenger.
moskov.brief: Once a valiant and fearless desert warrior, Moskov met his end on the battlefield against his rival Khaleed. But in death, his soul encountered a great vortex of darkness buried beneath the sand by the desert tyrant Khufra. For centuries, the Vortex incited discord among the desert tribes and harvested the dark energy borne from their bloodshed. Though the Vortex's insidious influence trapped the desert in a cycle of strife and anguish, the Vortex itself sought to be freed. Tempted with the promise of revenge, Moskov extracted the core of the vortex, the Spear of Quiescence, and was reborn in the power of the darkness. Now he roams the sands, seeking revenge upon Khufra in the name of the desert.

On his world, auto racing was the most illustrious sport, but the major races were almost entirely monopolized by the rich and elite. One day, while on a routine delivery, Johnson became mixed up in a race and even managed to win first place March, to the dismay of the wealthy patrons. To punish this upstart, they plotted for him to have an accident. While driving home a speeding truck sidelined Johnson's car, mangling his body with the twisted steel of the wreck. Miraculously, he survived, and chose to be integrated with his car to create a cyborg body. After a successful operation, he had a roaring engine as his new heart, and began racing to satiate his need for speed. As Johnson raced to his heart's content, he kept going faster and faster until he triggered the slip-space device secretly built into his chassis and crossed into the Land of Dawn.

harley.title: Mage Genius
harley.blurb: The young mage whose powers awakened once thrust into danger and who now arrives at the Magic Academy to study.
harley.brief: Heir to Castle Grandrock, Harley was of average talent and not considered with any importance by the Duke of Vance, his father. Yet he was always very close with his sister Lesley. To get his father's attention, he practiced conjuring to make it seem like he had magical abilities. Yet this had the unexpected result of getting him kidnapped. Lesley rushed to his rescue, and in the midst of his crisis his mighty magical powers were awakened. The two of them then proceeding to fight their way out. Ultimately, Leslie sent Harley to live and study at the Academy of Magic.

strong.d: Harley counters squishy heroes with poor mobility, such as Cecilion and Ixia, since he can deal burst damage while being on the move.

weak.d: Harley is countered by tanky heroes like Lolita and Uranus, because Harley can't deal enough meaningful damage to them and they can block and tank his Ultimate for their teammates.

irithel.title: Jungle Heart
irithel.blurb: The forest hunter with a smilodon.
irithel.brief: A jungle orphan raised by a smilodon, was rescued by Leonin Nana when she was almost caught by a human slave trader. With the help of Nana, she learned the human language and fighting skills, but she still didn't trust humans and only trusted her friend, a little tiger named Leo.

strong.d: Irithel counters heroes with a shorter Basic Attack range than her or ones that lack mobility and can be easily kited, such as Miya and Alpha.

weak.d: Irithel is countered by heroes with strong CC capabilities or can restrict movement, such as Badang and Silvanna. Because Irithel does not have any Blink skills, her advantage vanishes once her mobility is restricted.

grock.title: Fortress Titan
grock.brief: Through the morning mists of the Land of Dawn strides the towering Fortress Titan, pausing to listen as migrating birds share tales from distant shores. Though it has weathered countless ages as the last creation of the Ancient Ones, it still sees the world with the wonderment of a child. Upon its shoulders rests a broken castle tower-a most unlikely weapon-while the very stones of its composition were a record of the Ancient Ones' brave defiance across these lands. It roams the Land of Dawn in an endless quest, seeking both its creators and kindred spirits who will carry on the legacy of the Ancients.

While the Monastery of Light utilizes his powers to eradicate all heresy, it's never even acknowledged his existence. While Argus despises humankind, holding it in the utmost disdain, he once came into possession of a demonic blade in the midst of a battle and at that moment realized that he too was a son of man. That he was orphaned when his parents were slain by other humans. Under the demonic blade's curse he was overcome by resentment, falling into a demonic state himself as he became the Dark Angel.

odette.title: Swan Princess
odette.blurb: Innocent princess that grew up in the Swan Castle and genius mage that excels in sword and scepter.
odette.brief: As the daughter of Prince Alvin, Princess Odette was a romantic that seemed a well-behaved, obedient lady but actually yearned for adventures instead. After she became acquainted with Lancelot and rescued him in a duel ruckus, Odette slowly became aware of her own feelings towards Lancelot. Finally, she made the decision to leave the Swan Castle and set out on an adventure in search of her loved one.

Activate the dash from her Ultimate to reposition when enemies are about to escape, and finish them off with her 1st Skill after her Ultimate ends.
In the laning phase, use Odette's 1st Skill to harass the opponent, and immobilize them with her 2nd Skill at the right moment before securing the kill with her Ultimate.

assist.d: Pair Odette with heroes who can relocate their teammates like Johnson and Jawhead to make it easier for her to find the perfect position for her Ultimate.

strong.d: Odette's Ultimate is capable of unleashing massive damage and is effective against heroes lacking interruption skills, such as Layla and Irithel.

weak.d: Odette is countered by heroes with Crowd Control skills, such as Minotaur and Edith, because they can easily interrupt her Ultimate.

lancelot.title: Blade of Roses
lancelot.blurb: Prodigal son and genius swordsman of House Baroque.
lancelot.brief: As the eldest son of Duke Baroque, Lancelot was born rebellious. Dead set on resisting the political marriage arranged for him by his father, he traveled the country and led a licentious life instead. After being wounded at a drunken brawl in a tavern, Lancelot was rescued by Odette and finally came to realize what his heart truly yearned for. The prodigal son made a repentant return and thus began his adventure across the Land of Dawn.

In the laning phase, clear Minions by repeatedly using Lancelot's 1st Skill thanks to the cooldown reset, and stack his Passive before approaching the enemy and hitting them with his 2nd Skill.

assist.d: Lancelot works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, like Atlas and Tigreal, because they allow him to hit more enemies with his AOE skills.

strong.d: Lancelot counters long-range Mages, such as Cecilion and Pharsa, because there is a delay to their skills and Lancelot can use his 1st Skill to dodge them while going in for the kill.

weak.d: Lancelot is weak against heroes who can counter his mobility like Minsitthar and Phoveus, as his 1st Skill and Ultimate will be heavily restricted.

diggie.title: Timekeeper
diggie.blurb: The owl scholar who can control time.
diggie.brief: Diggie is a scholar from Eruditio. With his "Time Nest" Diggie can turn back time and even take others to a time travel with him unhindered by any outside forces.

d: Upon death, Diggie reverses time and turns back to egg form, in which he can continue to move around and gains a new set of skills. He cannot be targeted in egg form and will revive after a period of time.

strong.d: Diggie counters close range, CC focused heroes like Atlas and Lolita since he can pull them away and remove their CCs with his Ultimate.

weak.d: Diggie is countered by agile and bursty Assassins like Ling and Aamon because his own lack of defense makes him an easy target.

hylos.title: Grand Warden

In the laning phase, Zhask should start with his 1st Skill to summon a Nightmaric Spawn next to the enemy and follow up with his 2nd Skill to stun the target, then use his 3rd Skill for more damage.

assist.d: Zhask works best with heroes that can lock down enemies so he can have more time to deal damage, like Belerick and Lolita.

strong.d: Zhask is strong against burst damage heroes like Aldous and Paquito because his high HP after fusing with his Nightmaric Spawn, makes him tough to burst down.

weak.d: Zhask is countered by agile or long range heroes, such as Pharsa and Cecilion, because they can quickly step out of range of his immobile Nightmaric Spawn.

Yet he joined the Tribunal, executing traitors for the very same Sovereign-even his own kin. The Styx Clan had betrayed their master, but in order to survive, Helcurt would even betray his own people. And when the clans of the Abyss rose against the Sovereign, it was Helcurt who struck the fatal blow... Indeed, he was born in darkness and walked among darkness. A traitor by birth, however, even a traitor has the right to live. He will survive, and no one will stop him.

claude.title: Master Thief

vale.title: Windtalker

vale.brief: A magician of Wind Fort and the only genius in the entire family who can change the form of wind magic at will. Once a close friend of Valir of Fire Throat. granger.title: Death Chanter
granger.blurb: A mysterious demon hunter that operates outside the conventions of the Church of Light. Always seen with a violin case in hand, he hunts down demons with his two soul-devouring weapons.
granger.brief: Granger, a demon hunter who walks the line between human and demon, always preferred to keep to himself. But if someone could enter his world, they would realize how terrifying it is—the incessant howls and shrill cries constantly deafening his ears and heart. When he draws his demon-devouring weapons and unleashes a hail of bullets, the agonizing howls of demons become a requiem playing in the depths of his soul. Only the intertwining of their death shrieks and the sound of gunfire can drown out the noise that torments him daily. Each shot fired by Granger is not only his performance against the Abyss, but also an expression of his lament.

guinevere.title: Ms. Violet

ling.title: Cyan Finch

Though not born of demon blood, Dyrroth flourished in the depths of the Abyss by embracing it's savage nature. In a realm where power is revered above all, he willfully hastened his own corruption to prove his allegiance, reforging his flesh in the darkness and severing all bonds with the light.

But the appearance of Yu Zhong and the new Oriental Fighters opened a new chapter in his story. Baxia meditated on the choices he's made and realized that he could no longer cling to the past. Thus, he decided to let go of his burdens and focus on forging a new path. The roads he had walked will always be there, but the future is decided today.

Harmonizing Yin and Yang was not just her talent but also her vision for the world. It was then that she discovered her true identity as a descendant of the ancient Cadians. Now serving as Yu Zhong's loyal strategist, Luo Yi has taken his ambitions and meticulously set them into motion. However, hidden under her veil lies her own vision for the world.

The only passage that connects the Moniyan Empire is broken, separating the trapped refugees and the exiled wanderers from the rest of the world. They now live in fear and despair, haunted by monsters, yet still struggling to survive.

Then she can use her 1st Skill to switch to Nibiru, and cast Nibiru's Ultimate to attack the enemy. She can finish off the enemy heroes with her Basic Attacks and her 2nd Skill.

In the laning phase, we recommend using Renner as Beatrix's primary weapon and Wesker as her secondary weapon. She can use Renner's ranged Basic Attack to poke the enemy, and her 2nd Skill to reload and fire again. She can then switch to Wesker to finish off the target enemy.

strong.d: Beatrix is strong against heroes without movement abilities, as they can be easily hit by her skills, such as Hylos and Belerick.

assist.d: Beatrix works best with tank heroes with good CC abilities, as they can help improve the accuracy of Beatrix's skills. Like Khufra and Atlas.

weak.d: Beatrix is countered by high burst damage heroes with strong single-target CC, as they can catch her with a CC and burst her down. Such as Eudora and Ling.

His unit, consisting of fourteen hardened warriors, was well known among the locals for their reckless bravery, fighting against the Abyss using questionable yet effective methods. During one disastrous offensive by the Empire, Phoveus was forced to invoke the power of an Evil God to turn the tide. Despite the lives he saved, Phoveus was branded a sinner for conspiring with a demon. On the way to his execution, the Evil God attempted to take over Phoveus's body, but Phoveus took advantage of the situation to bind himself and the Evil God together in a stone monolith. While the Empire still condemns Phoveus as a sinner, those on the border will forever regard him as a hero.

In the laning phase, Phoveus should first use his enhanced Basic Attack to hit the enemy hero and gain a shield. Follow up with his 1st Skill to chip away their HP, then use his enhanced 1st Skill for additional damage and to slow the target, and end with his 2nd Skill for more damage.

strong.d: Enemies with multiple mobility abilities can greatly reduce Phoveus's cooldowns, so he can use his enhanced Basic Attacks and skills more often when facing heroes like Wanwan, Arlott, and Chou.

weak.d: Phoveus will struggle against ranged heroes with strong CC, such as Aurora, Valir, and Vexana.

Natan stood as Eruditio's leader, guiding the people in their search for hope in this world. Yet having faced numerous defeats he decided instead to cast his gaze not to the future, but to the past by inventing a time machine. As the world teetered on the brink of destruction, his time machine finally reached completion as it absorbed the combined power of the Twilight Orbs: Natan stepped within, and started searching the past for a chance to save the world.

weak.d: Natan is countered by heroes with targeted control and high burst like Saber and Eudora that can lock him down and finish him off.

Having walked the hero's path and inherited a hero's resolve, the glory of "Aulus" shall burn brightly within them both.

valentina.brief: In a battle against the Abyss' invasion, Valentina and her lover, Irlan, were betrayed by some members of House Paxley, which eventually caused Irlan to lose his soul. To revive her lover, Valentina made a deal with an Evil God and gained immortality in the power of shadow. Since then, she'd been hiding among the shadows, silently waiting for the appearance of the Heart of Anima–a broken piece from the Twilight Orb that was said to be the key to retrieving her lover's soul.

It was then that Edith remembered everything, but her humanity overpowered her divine nature, and she fought Uranus to protect her foster father. Just then, the Celestial Palace fell and the sealed Evil Gods scattered. Edith parted with her foster father, drove her Mecha "Phylax" and set out on a journey to hunt down fleeing Evil Gods.

Known as Yin, this simple and righteous martial artist sometimes exudes a sinister aura, creating a stark contrast that leaves many wary of him. Few know that his wild and violent behavior stems from the Evil God, Lieh, dwelling within him. He is the reason Yin left his home in the Cadia Riverlands—to hone himself in the Land of Dawn and find a way to defeat Lieh. But Yin's struggles in this foreign land have had the opposite effect; as a being that thrives on chaos, the more Yin fights, the faster Lieh can recover his power. Thus, Lieh began to impart his power to Yin, watching him sink deeper into madness with each act of righteousness and chivalry, and leading him toward the self-destruction Lieh desires. However, even knowing the risks, Yin continues to wield this power—because for him, abandoning his code and ignoring the suffering of others would make him no better than Lieh. khalea.title: Surging Wave
khalea.blurb: With her serpent tail, this proud descendant of the Great Serpent swims gracefully through the Vonetis Sea, aspiring to one day carry the full power of her heritage.
khalea.brief: The descendant of the legendary Great Serpent, Kalea once had trouble accepting her human-like body. But after discovering who she was, she learned to fight with her fists and powerful serpent tail while healing allies with the power of the Great Serpent surging inside her. Always full of energy, she is the proud protector of the Vonetis Sea. However, when faced with gratitude from others, she tends to put on a facade of arrogance to hide her shyness–after all, she has to live up to her reputation as the descendant of the Great Serpent!

strong.d: Kalea counters heroes who lack mobility like Layla and Chang'e.

zetian.title: Celestial Empress
zetian.blurb: Recognized by the Heavens and cherished by her people, the Celestial Empress of the Cadia Riverlands ascends to bring peace to the mortal realm.
zetian.brief: Zetian is the Empress of Shendu, Divine Capital of the Cadia Riverlands, as well as the "Tomb Keeper" who erected the unmarked monument in memory of the Ancient Ones. Millennia ago, she used the last of her phoenix spirit's power to create Shendu, a sanctuary for the mortals of the Cadia Riverlands. Exhausted by this feat, she fell into a deep slumber. A thousand years passed before she was reincarnated at the Lake of Reflection, and returned to the Divine Capital as a mortal to once again ascend to divinity. Over millennia of introspection, her resolve remained unshaken; the phoenix found its eternal roost in the Divine Capital. Now, she ascends the throne as Empress once more to usher in an era of unprecedented peace and prosperity for a realm in bloom.

assist.d: While Zetian already has decent survivability, when paired with supports who can protect allies like Floryn and Rafaela, Fighters with limited range will struggle even more to approach Zetian. And with the healing from these supports, Zetian can win any ranged battle of attrition.

strong.d: Zetian's Passive counters melee heroes with limited gap closers like Balmond and Zilong, allowing her to continue poking the enemy from a safe distance.

weak.d: Zetian's Ultimate can strike down anywhere on the map, but having such a powerful Ult means a hero like Valentina can also use it against Zetian's team.

obsidia.title: Sovereign of Dark's End
obsidia.blurb: The ancient Sovereign of the Abyss, risen from ruin, now seeks to slay the God of Darkness and hunt down its Spawns of Decay.
obsidia.brief: Obsidia once ruled the Abyss as its great sovereign, a figure of such terrible majesty that her subjects trembled in her presence, earning her the title of the Goddess of Death. In an ancient battle, she grievously wounded the God of Darkness, but was struck down by its vengeful power. Her remains have been sealed away by the subjects of the Abyss ever since. Now she has awakened from her remnants to find the God of Darkness's corrupting influence once again threatening her domain. Wielding weapons forged from her very bones, Obsidia hunts the Spawns of Decay, reclaiming her power with each kill, as she prepares to slay the God of Darkness once and for all.

assist.d: Obsidia usually reaches her damage potential in the mid-to-late game, so she wants support heroes who can help her in the early game, like Angela and Estes.

strong.d: Obsidia's Ultimate will disable dash and blink skills, making her excellent at countering heroes who rely on them, such as Hayabusa, Freya, and Lancelot.

weak.d: Obsidia struggles during the early laning phase, making her vulnerable to other Marksmen with strong early game, such as Bruno and Layla.

sora.title: Shifting Cloud
sora.blurb: A pure and free-spirited boy with unshakeable resolve, drifting across the golden sands.
sora.brief: Amidst the windswept sands of the Agelta Drylands, a boy named Sora drifts as freely as the flowing clouds. Pure and free-spirited, he wields fists wreathed in ever-shifting clouds—sometimes as thunderclouds crackling with fierce lightning, other times accumulating into thick cumulus clouds to shield against the desert's fury. Adventure calls to Sora like an alluring song, drawing him deep into uncharted desert ruins where he seeks out mysterious wonders. Yet the people know that when droughts loom and despair takes hold he will come riding the winds, bearing the precious rains their parched lands crave. Now Sora continues his journey along the ancient Emerald Road, carrying rain-bearing clouds to every corner of the desert, and hope to every desperate tribe.

combos.d: In mid-to-late game teamfights, Sora is able to adapt to different situations. He can ascend to Thunder form to dive the enemy backline, or Torrent form to become a CC machine and take control of the battlefield.

When the opponent is focused on clearing Minions, poke them with Sora's 1st Skill, then use his 2nd Skill to create distance. Use the mobility from his 1st and 2nd Skill to effectively kite enemies. Sora's damage is reliant on hitting with his 1st Skill.

assist.d: Sora's transformed Ultimate deals considerable damage, and pairing him with Tigreal, Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and other strong CC heroes will maximize Sora's damage potential.

strong.d: Sora excels at diving in with explosive burst damage and AOE CC, so squishy heroes without escape abilities—like Layla, Miya, and Hanabi—will find themselves helpless against Sora's relentless assault.

weak.d: Sora relies on landing his 1st Skill to get Cloudstep stacks. Heroes with high mobility or Knockbacks, like Fanny, Arlott, and Valir, can prevent Sora from gaining this precious resource.

marcel.title: Soul Photographer
marcel.blurb: Hailing from House Paxley, he is an elegant, mysterious, and bizarre artist whose split soul has fused with his camera.
marcel.brief: Marcel Paxley, the elegant yet mysterious talent from Castle Aberleen. He himself is a masterfully composed double exposure: the first exposure captured the refined character of House Paxley—Marcel, the boy; the second exposure captured a torn soul, fragmented by dark magic—Clemar, his camera. Since then, they have gazed at the world through two viewfinders. One maintains an impeccable veneer of elegance; the other carefully documents reality. Together, they believe pain is the best chemical for development, while imperfection defines true depth of field. Yet a completed work is always stands as its own individual "self."

strong.d: Marcel is more effective against low-mobility heroes, such as Layla and Vexana, as they are easily caught by his Ultimate, allowing him and his allies to secure easy kills.

weak.d: Heroes who possess Invincibility or Untargetable effects that can bypass Marcel's CC, like Ling and X.Borg, will reduce his impact on the battlefield.

assist.d: Because of Marcel's excellent AOE CC, he pairs well with allies with high AOE damage, like Hanabi and Ixia, to maximize their damage potential.

In teamfights, wait for the enemy backline to become isolated and use Hirara's 1st Skill to dive in. Use a 1st + 2nd Combo Skill to deal damage and apply CC, then follow up with a 2nd + 1st Combo Skill to burst the target down and dash out of the enemy formation. weak.d: However, while Hirara is quick and nimble, she is also quite fragile. Against burst Assassins with targeted abilities, such as Saber and Natalia, it can be difficult to predict their attacks and use her 2nd + 1st Combo Skill in time. If she gets caught, she'll be taken down instantly.

assist.d: Hirara has high damage output in the early-to-mid game, but the delay in her skills makes landing them less consistent. Hirara works especially well with strong early-game heroes with CC, such as Angela and Minotaur, allowing her to build an early advantage more easily.

strong.d: Hirara's high mobility allows her to dive the enemy backline with ease, making her an excellent counter to squishy heroes who lack self-protection, like Ixia and Pharsa.The untargetable effect from Hirara's 2nd + 1st Combo Skill is great against delayed skills that deal high damage, giving her a big advantage when facing heroes like Yin and Gusion.
